---
title: "Analyses"
subtitle: "Research that uses the scores on this site"
page-layout: article
---

Each analysis uses one or more attribute blocks of the data (the scores you see on every
manifesto page) and reports its numbers straight from its replication chain.

```{r list, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x
an <- yaml::read_yaml("_analyses.yml")$analyses
for (a in an) cat(sprintf(
  '::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}\n### [%s](%s.qmd)\n%s · %s · data: %s\n:::\n\n',
  a$title, a$id, a$authors_md %||% a$authors, a$status, paste(a$blocks, collapse = ", ")))
```

More attribute blocks, for example a party's environmental profile or its stance towards
democratic institutions, will appear on the manifesto pages as they are scored, each with its
own analysis page.
